pr_title: Complete ADR 0124 production navigation first release
pr_body:
Complete ADR 0124 on current main while preserving the existing NavMeshQuery and stable navigation component IDs. This follow-up adds engine-owned query-time traversal filtering for stable off-mesh link IDs and neutral traversal tags so doors and other dynamic traversal policies can disable baked links without exposing backend polygon/reference types.
